description: Cursor on Target (CoT) connector configuration for TAK mesh networking
_sourceOptions: source can be: 'multicast', 'broadcast', or 'tcp'. CoT no longer has its own TAK server connection - it rides the same TAK server connection configured in gva-app-bms's TAK Chat settings (host/port/TLS/p12), see TAK-SERVER.md.
_fileTransferNote: File transfer uses peer-to-peer HTTP over mesh network. httpServerPort is the local HTTP server port for serving files. autoDownload will automatically fetch files smaller than autoDownloadMaxSizeMB. Empty cacheDirectory uses system temp.
